summary: Flotek Industries filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $75.0 million senior secured term loan Credit Agreement dated September 23, 2026, with Alter Domus as administrative and collateral agent and an Elda River Capital affiliate as coordinating lead arranger. Net proceeds refinanced the existing PWRTEK Note and will fund capex and working capital. The facility adds $15.0 million committed delayed draw availability through June 30, 2027 and up to $30.0 million incremental delayed draws through March 31, 2028, subject to lender consent. This is a routine financing, not a special situation; watch leverage covenants and refinancing risk.
